entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Manuel de Oms y Santa Pau, 1st Marquess of Castelldosrius, Grandee of Spain was a Spanish diplomat, man of letters, and colonial official. From July 7, 1707, to April 22, 1710, he was viceroy of Peru.
